name: Move Account settings to Partner Portal
description:
## Why?

Partners manage their personal account in Core admin ("Nastavení účtu" / My Account) and their partner company + OAuth credentials separately in Admin → API Partner. The new Partner Portal (Figma) consolidates partner self-service in one place, starting with account settings.

## What?

Partner Portal gets a new Account settings page matching the Figma design. It shows the same fields as Core's My Account page (contact info, access/login data, language & date/time format, admin header color, notification preferences) built from shared components so both surfaces stay in sync without duplicating the implementation. Core's My Account page is unaffected. The Partner Portal page adds one more section with the partner's company details and OAuth client credentials, currently only available under Admin → API Partner (Settings and OAuth tabs).

## Acceptance criteria

Partner Portal has a new Account settings page reachable from its navigation, matching the linked Figma design.

The page shows the same fields as Core's My Account page, and saving them updates the same underlying account.

Core's My Account page is unchanged in behavior and appearance.

The Partner Portal page has an additional section for partner company details (today: Admin → API Partner → Settings) and OAuth client credentials (today: Admin → API Partner → OAuth).

Saving partner company details or OAuth settings from the Partner Portal produces the same result as saving them from the existing Admin → API Partner screens.

- Account-settings field groups need extracting into shared React components so both Core/pages/MyAccount and the new Partner Portal page render them without duplication.
